pros.example: stating plainly at the door that this is a life insurance appointment ends some meetings early and makes every remaining one defensible

cons.claim: Disclosure-first openings measurably reduce contact and appointment rates against competitors willing to obscure the purpose, and the honest agent absorbs that difference
cons.example: a mailer that plainly says life insurance draws fewer responses than one implying a benefits notice, and the honest piece must be funded anyway

failure_modes: letting a vendor's script or mail piece do the misleading on the agent's behalf
using a marketing name or an official-looking format that implies a government or benefits affiliation
keeping no evidence of consent for purchased records, so a complaint cannot be answered
acceptance_tests: every script, mail piece and outbound template opens with the agent's name, licensed-agent status and the life insurance purpose, contains no official or entitlement framing, and every contact record links to retained consent and suppression-list evidence
revisit_triggers: a complaint, a do-not-call dispute, or a vendor consent record that cannot be produced
a jurisdiction or channel changes its consent, do-not-call or inducement rules

nodes.definition: Prospect and client information collected in this business is nonpublic personal information that routinely includes health facts, and the practice is its custodian from the first phone note onward. The operating classes: collect only what the current stage actually needs, so health detail is gathered when it is needed for field underwriting rather than logged casually during prospecting; deliver the privacy and information-practices notices the applicable rules require, and obtain the authorizations the carrier's process depends on; store records in access-controlled systems rather than personal devices, unlocked spreadsheets and paper stacks in a car; transmit applications and health information through the carrier's or organization's secure channels rather than personal email or messaging apps; share with a carrier, organization or vendor only what the case requires and only where the contract permits; apply a retention and secure-destruction schedule consistent with record-keeping obligations, recognizing that files must often be kept for years after a case dies; and hold a written response for a suspected exposure, including who is notified and in what order. Marketing use of a client or prospect list is a separate consent question, and a lead vendor's data provenance is part of vendor selection rather than an afterthought.

included: stage-appropriate collection, required notices and authorizations
controlled storage, secure transmission and permitted sharing
retention, secure destruction and the written incident response
marketing use as a separate consent question
excluded: the specific privacy, notice and retention rules of any jurisdiction or carrier, which must be verified currently
medical interpretation of any health information collected

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a security incident occurs or a carrier, vendor or jurisdiction changes privacy and retention requirements

pros.claim: Treating the file as custodial from first contact prevents the quiet accumulation of sensitive data in places that cannot be secured or produced
pros.example: health answers live only in the carrier's secure application rather than in a personal note-taking app synchronized to a phone

cons.claim: Secure handling adds friction to a field process that runs on speed and mobile devices, and the compliant path is usually the slower one
cons.example: a client's follow-up health detail must wait for the secure channel rather than being captured in a quick message thread

failure_modes: sending applications or health information through personal email or messaging apps for convenience
keeping prospect data indefinitely in personal spreadsheets with no retention or destruction schedule
reusing a client list for marketing or recruiting purposes it was never consented to
acceptance_tests: prospect and client records live only in named access-controlled systems, required notices and authorizations are evidenced per file, a retention and destruction schedule exists, and a written incident-response step names who is notified first
revisit_triggers: a suspected exposure, lost device or vendor security incident
a change in carrier, vendor or jurisdiction privacy and retention requirements

nodes.definition: Define the single gate that must pass before the practice solicits its first prospect, and re-run it whenever the footprint, carrier set or market changes. The pass conditions: the resident license is active with the life line of authority; every state to be solicited has an active nonresident license and the intended carrier appointment is in force or that state's and carrier's just-in-time rule has been verified with its window; errors-and-omissions coverage is in force; the continuing-obligations calendar exists with owners, dates and lead times; the affiliation contract's ownership, vesting, release and debit-balance terms are abstracted in plain language and knowingly accepted; the product shelf has a named primary and backup for each need class the market presents, with the compensation mechanism abstracted per product; the market focus is written with its unit-economics model, its inputs dated and its persistency assumption labelled; lead sources are vetted with consent provenance evidenced; the disclosure-first contact script and the vulnerable-consumer protocol are written; marketing assets carry approval evidence; and the privacy handling, storage locations and retention schedule are defined. A failure holds only what it actually affects - that state, that carrier, that market segment - rather than the whole practice, and the failed condition is named in writing so it can be cleared rather than forgotten. Passing this gate is the handoff into needs analysis and suitability work.

included: the enumerated pass conditions covering authority, contract terms, shelf, market, leads, conduct and data
the scoped-hold rule that fails a state, carrier or segment rather than the practice
the handoff into needs analysis and suitability work
excluded: the case-level readiness of any individual client file, which belongs to the needs analysis knowledge base
in-force book performance measures, which belong to the book building knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the footprint, carrier set or market segment changes, or an authority condition lapses

pros.claim: One enumerated gate converts a scattered set of preconditions into a checkable state, and the scoped hold lets a ready practice start where it is genuinely ready
pros.example: a missing appointment in a second state holds only that state's prospecting while the resident-state pipeline runs normally

cons.claim: The gate delays first income at the moment cash pressure is highest, which is exactly when an agent is most tempted to waive a condition
cons.example: leads are already purchased and appointments booked while one carrier appointment is still pending, creating pressure to solicit before authority exists

failure_modes: waiving a condition informally because a specific opportunity is waiting
passing the gate once and never re-running it when a state, carrier or market is added
recording a pass without the evidence artifact behind each condition
acceptance_tests: every pass condition is marked met with its evidence artifact referenced, and any unmet condition is recorded with the specific state, carrier or segment it holds and the action required to clear it
revisit_triggers: a state, carrier, product or market segment is added or changed
an authority condition lapses, or a complaint or audit finding questions the practice's readiness

edges.why_related: what the practice intends to sell decides which line of authority is pursued and which requirement classes apply
a carrier will not appoint a producer who does not already hold the license the appointment attaches to
nonresident licenses are commonly issued on the strength of an active resident license through reciprocity
each appointment and contract adds carrier-owned training, certification and reporting obligations to the calendar
the charter's product classes and refusal list bound which markets the practice can honestly serve
the chosen model determines which agreement's ownership, vesting and release clauses must be abstracted
the hierarchy the producer joins sets the contract level and the support bundled into it
a compensation schedule can only be read correctly against the producer's actual contract level
the chosen market determines which impairment, occupation and program classes the appetite map must cover
the need classes the chosen market presents define the slots the shelf must fill
only carriers accepted on claims-paying durability are eligible to occupy a shelf slot
appetite coverage across the market's recurring risk classes decides which primary and backup pairing actually works
a carrier whose application, underwriting and service operations fail testing cannot hold a slot regardless of its rate
there must be a shelf with named slots before a review cadence and concentration limit can be applied to it
which lead classes can reach the chosen buyers at all is decided by who those buyers are
choosing the final-expense and senior market is what makes the heightened care protocol mandatory rather than optional
entering the business-owner market is what puts the practice against the legal and tax advice boundary
the source classes in use determine which consent, contact and inducement obligations the practice must satisfy
acquisition cost and contact rates in the economics chain come from the actual sources in use
the compensation and payment-timing mechanism supplies the revenue and cash-flow side of the economics chain
the gate cannot pass until every need class the market presents has a filled and appointed shelf slot
the gate requires a live obligations calendar with owners and dates, not merely current licenses
the gate requires the disclosure-first script and evidenced consent provenance before any prospect is contacted
the charter's claim boundary sets the outer limit of what any advertisement, title or designation may assert
the vulnerable-buyer protocol removes urgency, fear and entitlement framings from prospecting regardless of their measured response rates
a vendor whose data provenance and consent trail cannot be evidenced is disqualified as a source however well it performs
release conditions and waiting periods limit how freely carrier contracts can actually be moved when a review calls for a change
the higher contract level or richer support package is frequently offered in exchange for tighter release, exclusivity or vesting terms
edges.resolution_rule: ownership terms win: a contract-level advantage can be renegotiated or outgrown, a book that cannot be moved cannot; accept a level-for-restriction trade only when the release path is written, time-bounded and recorded in the contract abstract with a dated review

edges.why_related: the product or carrier that compensates best is not reliably the one the chosen market's need classes call for
edges.resolution_rule: the need class fills its slot first: compensation may break a tie between two options that both genuinely fit the need, and may never select an option that does not; where compensation influenced a close call the reason is written into the slot's justification

edges.why_related: the cheapest and highest-volume sources tend to carry the weakest consent provenance and the most aggressive framing
edges.resolution_rule: no source is used whose consent and do-not-call provenance cannot be produced on demand, whatever its cost per placed case; a source whose evidence is missing is suspended rather than discounted, and a vendor script that obscures the insurance purpose is rejected outright

edges.why_related: the economics chain rewards throughput and short cycle times while the care protocol deliberately slows or stops transactions
edges.resolution_rule: the care protocol wins over cadence without exception: where a vulnerability signal is present the process slows, involves a trusted person, or stops and is documented, and the economics model absorbs the lower throughput rather than the buyer absorbing the pressure

edges.why_related: a captive or restrictive affiliation may not permit a carrier the chosen market's need classes genuinely require
edges.resolution_rule: the client's need class is never reshaped to fit the available shelf: either the affiliation permits a brokered placement for that slot in writing, or that case class is referred out and the referral recorded, and a repeated gap becomes a trigger to re-open the affiliation decision

edges.why_related: the break-even model argues for producing immediately while the gate withholds solicitation until every condition is evidenced
edges.resolution_rule: readiness conditions are never waived for income pressure; because the gate is scoped per state, per carrier and per market segment, the practice starts wherever it is genuinely ready and records the named condition holding everything else

edges.why_related: accurate appetite routing raises the placement rate, which moves acquisition cost per placed case more than lead price does
degraded underwriting turnaround or policyholder service is one of the observations that triggers an off-cycle shelf review
the obligations calendar is built the day the first license is issued, not when the first renewal notice arrives
review findings send a slot back to be refilled with a replacement contracted before the incumbent is dropped
measured economics that miss the model for consecutive cycles send the market focus itself back to be re-tested rather than funded harder
both are boundary disciplines that constrain what the agent may do inside a commercially attractive market, and both are enforced by refusing work rather than by doing it better

conflict_axes.name: captive_support_vs_independent_ownership
conflict_axes.description: Structured training, infrastructure and early subsidy come from the models that most restrict product access and most often hold the client relationship, while ownership and product freedom come with the full cost of running a business alone.
poles: take the support and accept the restrictions
take ownership and carry the whole cost
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: decide on the four durable axes - relationship ownership, exit terms, real price of support, product access for the chosen market - and treat any early subsidy as the least important term in the agreement

conflict_axes.name: shelf_breadth_vs_carrier_depth
conflict_axes.description: A wide shelf covers more cases but dilutes product knowledge, multiplies certifications and appointment maintenance, and can leave the practice short of every carrier's production expectations; a narrow shelf builds depth and better terms but forces awkward fits.
poles: carry fewer carriers for depth and terms
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: size the shelf by need classes rather than carrier count - one primary and one backup per slot the chosen market actually presents - and add a carrier only when a real recurring case class has nowhere honest to go

conflict_axes.name: contract_level_vs_bundled_support
conflict_axes.description: A higher contract level and a package of leads, training, technology and case support are alternative uses of the same compensation stream, and the recruiting conversation rarely itemizes which one is being sold.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: price both sides on one carrier and one product, value the bundled services at what they would cost bought directly, list every attached condition, and record the comparison before signing

conflict_axes.name: lead_volume_vs_consent_provenance
conflict_axes.description: The sources that deliver the most contacts for the least money are the ones whose consent records, data origin and calling scripts are hardest to evidence when a complaint arrives.
poles: buy the volume the pipeline needs
buy only what can be evidenced
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: make producible consent and do-not-call evidence a precondition of using any source at any price, and suspend rather than discount a source whose trail cannot be produced

conflict_axes.name: income_urgency_vs_focus_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Early in a practice every case feels necessary, which argues for writing whatever appears; compounding knowledge, carrier fit and referrals argues for declining or referring anything outside the chosen market.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the focus for prospecting and lead spend while allowing inbound out-of-focus cases through a written protocol that either partners them or refers them out, so the exception is recorded rather than becoming the practice

conflict_axes.name: persuasive_framing_vs_disclosure_first
conflict_axes.description: Response rates rise when the purpose of a contact is obscured or dramatized and fall when the agent opens by naming themselves, their licensed status and the life insurance purpose.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat disclosure-first as a fixed constraint and optimize only inside it - better targeting, better offers, better timing - and fund the lower response rate as a cost of doing business honestly

conflict_axes.name: compensation_attractiveness_vs_client_fit
conflict_axes.description: Products, carriers and funding designs differ in what they pay the producer, and the better-paying option is not reliably the one that fits the need class in front of the practice.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: fit decides the slot and the recommendation; compensation may only break a tie between options that both genuinely fit, and the reason is written into the justification so the pattern can be audited later

conflict_axes.name: footprint_expansion_vs_compliance_load
conflict_axes.description: Every additional state opens more cases and adds another license renewal, education requirement, appointment set and body of advertising, replacement and contact rules to maintain correctly.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: add a state only on demonstrated repeated demand or an explicit market that straddles a border, and add its obligations to the calendar in the same act as adding the license

conflict_axes.name: speed_to_first_sale_vs_readiness_gate
conflict_axes.description: Cash pressure is highest exactly when the foundation is least complete, so the gate's conditions are under most pressure at the moment they matter most.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: scope the gate per state, per carrier and per market segment so the practice can begin wherever it is genuinely ready, and never waive an authority, consent or conduct condition for a specific opportunity

edge_cases.description: Continuing-education credits are missed and the license lapses while applications are pending and clients are waiting on delivery
edge_cases.trigger: a renewal or education deadline passes without completion
edge_cases.mitigation: stop soliciting immediately, notify the affected carriers and confirm the status of pending business and any reinstatement path with the department, and rebuild the calendar with lead times long enough to absorb a busy month before resuming

edge_cases.description: An organization offers a materially higher contract level conditioned on a long release restriction and a production minimum the chosen market cannot honestly produce
edge_cases.trigger: a recruiting offer trades compensation for movement and volume conditions
edge_cases.mitigation: price the level difference against the bundled support at direct cost, model whether the minimum is reachable without writing unsuitable business, and decline unless the release path is written and time-bounded

edge_cases.description: A carrier discontinues or reprices the single product the chosen market's core need class depends on
edge_cases.trigger: a product withdrawal, repricing or underwriting-class restructure at a primary carrier
edge_cases.mitigation: activate the backup carrier already contracted for that slot, re-run the affected part of the economics model, and treat the event as a trigger to check whether the concentration limit was already breached

edge_cases.description: A final-expense prospect cannot recall the purpose of the appointment and an adult child answers every question and presses for a signature
edge_cases.trigger: capacity and third-party pressure signals appear in the same appointment
edge_cases.mitigation: stop the sales process, reschedule so the buyer can participate directly with a trusted person of their own choosing present, document the signals observed and the decision, and decline the sale entirely if capacity remains in question

edge_cases.description: A purchased internet lead's consent language does not match how the record is actually being contacted, and the vendor cannot produce the original consent capture
edge_cases.trigger: a consent trail is requested and cannot be produced by the vendor
edge_cases.mitigation: suspend the source immediately, stop contacting the unevidenced records, add them to internal suppression, and require producible consent capture as a contractual condition before any further purchase

edge_cases.description: The producer moves to a new upline and the incumbent refuses a release, blocking new business with the carriers held through it
edge_cases.trigger: a hierarchy move is attempted without a written release path
edge_cases.mitigation: work the contract's stated waiting-period mechanism rather than improvising, keep servicing existing clients within the contract's terms, and route new cases to shelf carriers held outside the disputed hierarchy

edge_cases.description: A client relocates or is physically present in a state the producer is not licensed in when the solicitation would occur
edge_cases.trigger: the applicant's location no longer matches the producer's licensed footprint
edge_cases.mitigation: pause the solicitation, confirm with the carrier and the relevant department which state's authority the case requires, and either obtain the nonresident license and appointment or refer the case to a properly licensed producer

edge_cases.description: Leads supplied as a benefit of affiliation turn out to be charged against future compensation, and a slow month converts the arrangement into a growing debit balance
edge_cases.trigger: production falls below what the bundled lead charges assume
edge_cases.mitigation: stop the lead flow while the balance is understood, obtain the accounting in writing, model the exposure against realistic placement rates, and renegotiate or exit the arrangement before the balance becomes a barrier to contracting elsewhere

edge_cases.description: A social post or mailer uses a carrier's logo without written approval or a title implying advisory or government status
edge_cases.trigger: a prospect-facing asset is published outside the approval path
edge_cases.mitigation: remove the asset, notify the carrier if its marks were used, replace it with an approved version, and route every channel including personal social profiles through the same review path

edge_cases.description: A shelf carrier is downgraded or acquired after clients have already been placed with it
edge_cases.trigger: a rating, outlook or ownership change at a carrier holding in-force business
edge_cases.mitigation: re-run the acceptance assessment for new business, decide separately whether the carrier keeps its slot going forward, and never convert the news into a reason to approach existing policyholders about replacing coverage

edge_cases.description: A referral partner such as a funeral home, employer or association asks to be compensated for sending prospects
edge_cases.trigger: a referral arrangement is proposed that involves payment or a shared inducement
edge_cases.mitigation: treat compensated referral, unlicensed-party compensation and anti-rebating as obligation classes to verify in that state and with the carrier before agreeing to anything, and decline or restructure the arrangement until it is confirmed permissible in writing

edge_cases.description: A business-owner prospect asks the agent to draft, interpret or fix the buy-sell agreement the coverage is meant to fund
edge_cases.trigger: a legal or tax determination is requested from the agent inside an otherwise ordinary case
edge_cases.mitigation: use the charter's referral sentence, put the specific question to the client's attorney or accountant in writing, record the answer received, and build the coverage amount and ownership structure only on what they supply

workflow.action: Write the practice scope and refusal charter
workflow.description: State what the practice sells, what it refuses, who out-of-scope questions go to, and the standing no-guarantee language
workflow.artifact: practice charter with refusal list and referral partners
workflow.gate: the offered product classes, at least one refusal category with its referral professional, and the no-guarantee sentence are written and match every planned marketing asset

workflow.description: Identify the state's current requirement classes in order and complete each, collecting its evidence artifact
workflow.artifact: active resident license record with the life line of authority and a filed evidence set
workflow.gate: the license shows the life line of authority active with its number and expiration, and each requirement class in the state's current publication has a matching artifact

workflow.action: Choose and document the market focus
workflow.description: Answer the five fit-test questions honestly against real access, capacity and knowledge, and define the out-of-focus case protocol
workflow.artifact: written market focus statement with the fit test answered
workflow.gate: all five fit-test questions are answered from actual access and capacity, and the protocol for out-of-focus cases names where they go

workflow.action: Decide the affiliation model and abstract the contract terms
workflow.description: Score candidate models on product access, cost borne, relationship ownership and exit, then abstract vesting, ownership, release and forfeiture clauses in plain language
workflow.artifact: affiliation decision memo with a plain-language contract-term abstract
workflow.gate: each candidate is scored on the four axes and the abstract covers vesting, agent-of-record and client-list ownership, release and waiting period, non-solicitation, orphan handling and forfeiture triggers

workflow.action: Read the compensation schedule at the actual contract level
workflow.description: Abstract per product how compensation is computed, paid, charged back and treated on replacements, at the level actually offered
workflow.gate: each intended product has a dated abstract naming premium basis, first-year and renewal structure, advance or as-earned mechanism, chargeback window and replacement treatment, sourced from the current schedule

workflow.action: Contract and obtain appointments for the intended carriers and states
workflow.description: Complete contracting packets, disclose history accurately, and record appointment status per carrier and per state
workflow.artifact: authority register of carrier and state appointments with effective dates
workflow.gate: every intended carrier and state pairing shows an in-force appointment or a verified just-in-time rule with its window, and errors-and-omissions coverage is evidenced

workflow.action: Build the product shelf against the market's need classes
workflow.description: Fill one slot per need class with a primary and backup carrier accepted on strength, appetite and service testing
workflow.artifact: shelf map of need classes to primary and backup carriers with written reasons
workflow.gate: every need class the chosen market presents has a filled slot with an appointed primary and backup and a written reason, and no carrier sits on the shelf without filling a slot

workflow.action: Select and vet the lead sources
workflow.description: Choose source classes that reach the chosen market, verify consent provenance, and size volume to appointment capacity
workflow.artifact: vendor and source register with consent evidence and capacity limits
workflow.gate: each active source has its class, producible consent and do-not-call provenance, and a weekly volume the practice can actually serve

workflow.action: Write the disclosure-first contact protocol and the vulnerable-consumer procedure
workflow.description: Draft the opening used on every first contact, the prohibited framings, and the protections applied when a vulnerability signal appears
workflow.artifact: contact scripts, prohibited-framing list and vulnerable-consumer protocol
workflow.gate: every script and outbound template opens with name, licensed-agent status and the life insurance purpose, carries no official or entitlement framing, and the protocol names the signals and the protective responses including stopping

workflow.action: Model the niche unit economics from measured inputs
workflow.description: Populate the chain from acquisition cost to cash with dated measured inputs or explicit assumptions, including the persistency assumption
workflow.artifact: unit-economics model with dated, sourced inputs
workflow.gate: every input is dated and either measured with its method stated or labelled an assumption, and the model reports the acquisition-cost to first-year-compensation ratio and the time from spend to cash

workflow.action: Build the continuing-obligations calendar and the data-handling rules
workflow.description: Load every recurring obligation for every licensed state and contracted carrier with owner, cadence and lead time, and define storage, transmission and retention for prospect data
workflow.gate: no obligation is past due, every item has an owner, due date, lead-time reminder and evidence field, and record storage, secure transmission and retention rules are written

workflow.description: Check every pass condition with its evidence and scope any failure to the affected state, carrier or segment
workflow.artifact: signed readiness record with evidence references
workflow.gate: every condition is marked met with its evidence artifact referenced, and any unmet condition names the state, carrier or segment it holds and the action required to clear it

priority_rationale: The frame and authority units come first because nothing in this practice may lawfully happen before the charter, the license, the appointments and the obligations that keep them alive are in place; the affiliation and contract-term units follow because they fix for years who owns the book and how compensation reaches the producer, and they are effectively unrepairable after signing; market focus precedes carrier and product work because the need classes it defines are what the shelf, the appetite map and the lead architecture are built to serve; lead generation, vulnerable-consumer care, professional boundaries and data custody sit downstream of focus because they govern how the chosen market is actually approached; and the readiness gate comes last because it composes every prior unit into one evidenced, scoped decision to begin soliciting and hands off to needs analysis and suitability work.

dominance_rules.rule: Licensure and appointment authority dominate every sales opportunity
dominance_rules.rationale: unlicensed or unappointed solicitation exposes the producer to regulatory action, voids the transaction and can forfeit compensation, and no case is worth that outcome
dominance_rules.trigger: a prospect, referral or case appears in a state or for a carrier where authority is not confirmed in force
dominance_rules.action: do not solicit, quote or take an application; obtain the authority or refer the case to a properly licensed producer and record the referral

dominance_rules.rule: Disclosure-first identification dominates any marketing framing or response-rate argument
dominance_rules.rationale: a contact obtained by obscuring its purpose taints everything that follows and is the origin of most conduct complaints
dominance_rules.trigger: any script, mail piece, advertisement or vendor approach that hides or dramatizes the insurance purpose
dominance_rules.action: rewrite it to open with name, licensed-agent status and the life insurance purpose, or do not use it

dominance_rules.rule: Client fit dominates compensation attractiveness in every product, carrier and design choice
dominance_rules.rationale: compensation-led selection is the mechanism by which unsuitable business is written, and it is visible in hindsight to regulators, carriers and clients alike
dominance_rules.trigger: the better-compensating option differs from the option that fits the documented need class
dominance_rules.action: select on fit; use compensation only to break a tie between options that both fit, and write the reason into the justification

dominance_rules.rule: Vulnerable-consumer protection dominates the close, the appointment schedule and the economics model
dominance_rules.rationale: the harm from an unsuitable or unaffordable sale to someone who could not evaluate it is severe, often irreversible, and falls on the person least able to absorb it
dominance_rules.trigger: any capacity, isolation, third-party-pressure or affordability signal during contact or appointment
dominance_rules.action: slow down, involve a trusted person of the buyer's choosing, verify affordability and understanding, and stop and document the decision where capacity remains in question

dominance_rules.rule: Written contract terms dominate verbal recruiting promises
dominance_rules.rationale: ownership, vesting, release and forfeiture are enforced from the document, and the person who made the promise may not be there when it matters
dominance_rules.trigger: a recruiting representation about ownership, release, leads or compensation that is not in the signed agreement
dominance_rules.action: require the term in writing in the agreement or its addendum, or treat it as absent when comparing offers

dominance_rules.rule: Carrier claims-paying durability dominates a marginally better rate or compensation on a long-duration promise
dominance_rules.rationale: the product is a promise that may be called decades later, and price advantage means nothing if the carrier mistreats or cannot serve the in-force block
dominance_rules.trigger: a candidate carrier is attractive on rate or compensation but weaker on strength, in-force behaviour or service
dominance_rules.action: keep it off the shelf or restrict it to slots where duration and in-force exposure are limited, and record the reasoning

dominance_rules.rule: Producible consent and do-not-call status dominate lead volume and cost per lead
dominance_rules.rationale: a contact that cannot be shown to have been permitted is a complaint waiting to be filed and cannot be defended after the fact
dominance_rules.trigger: a source, vendor or record whose consent capture or suppression status cannot be produced on request
dominance_rules.action: suspend the source, stop contacting the affected records, add them to suppression, and require producible evidence as a contractual condition

dominance_rules.rule: Current jurisdiction verification dominates remembered rules, training-manual statements and peer practice
dominance_rules.rationale: licensing, advertising, contact and replacement requirements differ by state and change, and every specific in this knowledge base is a class rather than a current rule
dominance_rules.trigger: any decision that depends on a specific requirement, deadline, window or permitted claim
dominance_rules.action: verify the current rule with the relevant insurance department, carrier or the practice's own compliance counsel before acting, and record what was verified and when

dominance_rules.rule: The readiness gate dominates first-sale urgency and purchased-lead pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: a foundation completed under pressure is the one that fails an audit or a complaint, and the cost of waiting is always smaller than the cost of an unauthorized or unevidenced sale
dominance_rules.trigger: an opportunity or a lead spend arrives while any gate condition is unmet
dominance_rules.action: hold only the affected state, carrier or segment, name the failed condition in writing, and proceed elsewhere in the practice

dominance_rules.rule: Professional boundaries dominate the value of a large case
dominance_rules.rationale: tax, legal, valuation and medical determinations belong to licensed professionals, and giving them informally exposes the client to bad structure and the agent to liability far beyond the case
dominance_rules.trigger: a request for a tax, legal, valuation, investment or medical determination inside any case
dominance_rules.action: use the charter's referral sentence, put the question in writing to the client's own professional, record the answer, and build only on what they supply

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the license and the carrier and state appointment before booking an appointment, buying a lead for that state, or taking any application
anti_rework_rules.prevents: solicitation without authority, voided or unpaid business, and a regulatory exposure that no later correction removes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Choose the market focus before selecting carriers, products or lead sources
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a shelf, an appetite map and a lead budget built for a market the practice does not actually serve, all of which must be rebuilt

anti_rework_rules.rule: Abstract ownership, vesting, release and forfeiture terms before writing the first application under a contract
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering after years of production that the book cannot be moved, renewals do not vest, or past clients cannot be contacted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the compensation schedule and its chargeback mechanics before quoting a product
anti_rework_rules.prevents: cash-flow surprises from advances, unmodelled chargeback exposure, and mid-case product switching when the real mechanics emerge

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify consent provenance and do-not-call handling with a vendor before the first purchase and the first dial
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unusable lead file, records that must be suppressed after payment, and complaints that cannot be answered

anti_rework_rules.rule: Route every prospect-facing asset through carrier and state review before it goes public
anti_rework_rules.prevents: takedowns, carrier disputes over marks, and re-creating a marketing library after a compliance finding

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the continuing-obligations calendar the day the first license is issued
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a lapse-driven stoppage of pending business and the reinstatement work that follows an expiry nobody was tracking

anti_rework_rules.rule: Model the niche unit economics before committing a lead budget or accepting a production minimum
anti_rework_rules.prevents: spending into a market whose acquisition cost cannot be covered, and signing volume conditions that can only be met by writing unsuitable business

anti_rework_rules.rule: Contract and appoint a backup carrier for each need slot before dropping or losing the incumbent
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an empty slot while cases are arriving, and the temptation to place a case with whichever carrier happens to be available

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the referral protocol for tax, legal and valuation questions before entering the business-owner market
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an informal answer that misstructures a case and the unwinding, liability and relationship damage that follow

iteration_protocol.trigger: a shelf carrier discontinues or reprices a product, or is downgraded, acquired or found to have degraded service
iteration_protocol.action: run an off-cycle shelf review, activate or contract the backup for the affected slot before dropping the incumbent, and re-check the concentration limit

iteration_protocol.trigger: a lead source's measured cost per placed case drifts outside the modelled band
iteration_protocol.action: re-measure the chain stage by stage to find which rate moved, re-vet the source, and adjust spend or capacity before adding budget

iteration_protocol.trigger: a regulatory, departmental or carrier notice changes a licensing, education, advertising, contact or appointment requirement
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the affected obligation class in every licensed state, update the calendar, scripts and asset library, and record what was verified and when

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint, a consent dispute, or a concern about a vulnerable buyer is raised
iteration_protocol.action: suspend the source or practice involved, review the contact protocol and the specific file, correct the process before resuming, and document the outcome

iteration_protocol.trigger: a move to a different upline, organization or affiliation model is contemplated or forced
iteration_protocol.action: re-read ownership, vesting, release, non-solicitation and debit-balance terms and confirm the release path in writing before any contract is moved or new business is written elsewhere

iteration_protocol.trigger: repeated ratings, declines or requirement escalations appear in one risk class
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the appetite map from current underwriting guides and actual outcomes, and add or re-route to a carrier that fits the class

iteration_protocol.trigger: the market focus misses its modelled economics or its access channel for consecutive cycles
iteration_protocol.action: re-test the focus itself with the five fit-test questions rather than adding products or spending more on the same source

iteration_protocol.trigger: the practice adds a state, a carrier, a product class or a new market segment
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the readiness gate scoped to that addition, adding its licensing, appointment, obligation, advertising and conduct conditions before soliciting there
